portal.vendor_source: portal markup fingerprint (bespoke ASP.NET WebForms; no vendor signature)

quirks.summary: PlanIt's areas directory returns NO record for this council, but its applics records do - and they carry the detail URL pattern.
quirks.detail: Confirmed 2026-09-30. api/areas/json?auths=Telford+and+Wrekin returns nothing, so the usual resolution path yields no portal. api/applics/json?auth=Telford returns applications whose url is https://secure.telford.gov.uk/planning/pa-applicationsummary.aspx?applicationnumber=<REF>, which is how this portal was resolved at all.
quirks.workaround: When areas returns nothing, pull a recent applic and read the portal off its url.

quirks.summary: Detail pages are constructible straight from the human reference - no opaque id and no session needed.
quirks.detail: pa-applicationsummary.aspx?applicationnumber=<REF> returns HTTP 200 with the case, and links on to pa-documents-public.aspx?Applicationnumber=<REF> and pa-plansboard-public.aspx?Applicationnumber=<REF>. Useful: a reference is all you need to reach the case.

quirks.summary: No document file links could be reached: the documents and plans-board pages render as chrome with no file rows.
quirks.detail: Tried 2026-09-30 on TWC/2026/0687: pa-documents-public.aspx returns 200 as a tab shell whose only links are __doPostBack targets (App_Documents, Documents, App_Plans); posting the App_Documents postback with __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION echoed returned 200 and a slightly larger page with still no file links; pa-plansboard-public.aspx likewise. Whether this application simply has no published documents was not established - only one application was tried on the document route.
quirks.workaround: Hand the user the detail page. Before concluding the install publishes nothing, try several applications.

quirks.summary: The date search returns the search form again rather than results, and the form's own action 404s from /planning/.
quirks.detail: The search app lives at /planningsearch/, not /planning/: the form's action="search.aspx" 404s if resolved against /planning/. Posted to /planningsearch/search.aspx with DCdatefrom/DCdateto as dd/mm/yyyy, with btnSearchPlanningDetails as a value and again as __EVENTTARGET: HTTP 200 both times, no result rows. Cause not established.
quirks.workaround: Reach cases by reference via PlanIt applics rather than through the date search.

browser_route.note: Detail page is constructible from the human reference; the documents route was not established.

verification.note: New entry, resolved off PlanIt applics because its areas directory has no record. Bespoke ASP.NET WebForms, no WAF and no CAPTCHA. Detail pages work by human reference; the date search returns the form with no rows and no document file links were reached, so partial rather than tested-ok.
